# Switch NX2 - read when the Hortensia GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\hortensia\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/hortensia/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
# Beside-application files accept EDEN_NX2_* and the emulator's diagnostic switches only.
# Host environment settings, including library paths such as EDEN_STREAMLINE_DIR, must be
# set in the real environment or the user configuration file at an absolute config location.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Performance tuning defaults for Switch 2 ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to the back thread (SPLIT=2 delivers up to +54% FPS alone).
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) copies back
# 90-220 MB/s of buffers CPU never touches, causing heavy mutex contention and dropping FPS by ~38-63%.
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# Which fence the game waits for when it presents. 1 = the previous frame's: the game prepares the
# next frame while the GPU finishes this one, and waits for this one too while the GPU is behind.
# 0 = this frame's: no overlap. Any value other than 1 means 0, so =2 does not run two frames ahead.
# Unset: per title. Ocarina of Time uses 1, Donkey Kong Bananza 0, and other titles wait for this
# frame unless a GPU channel waits on a semaphore the game releases after the present.
# Ocarina of Time with =0 (or =2): 30.9 fps against 38.9 unset, same spot and settings.
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=1

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can reduce FPS from 29 to 24 in MKW).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1

# --- Hortensia: optimizations ported from other forks (on by default; uncomment a line to undo it) ---
# Selevet: SEM_EXECUTE acquires release fences on the back thread instead of draining
#EDEN_NX2_SEMEXEC_DRAIN=1
# Selevet: poll the host GPU up to 300 us before sleeping in the driver
#EDEN_NX2_GPU_WAIT_SPIN_US=0
# Selevet: high process priority (Windows)
#EDEN_NX2_HIGH_PRIORITY=0
# Selevet: tell the Switch 2 SDK the display supports VRR (steadier game speed)
#EDEN_NX2_REPORT_VRR=0
# Orchid / Eglantine-DKB: skip unchanged vertex buffer checks
#EDEN_NX2_DRAW_TUNING=0
# Eglantine-DKB: skip draws with no vertices or no instances
#EDEN_NX2_DRAW_EMPTY=1
# Skip Switch 2 draws while their pipeline builds instead of stopping the game to wait for it (with
# asynchronous shaders on; an effect can be missing for a moment). =0 waits for every build.
EDEN_NX2_ASYNC_SKIP=1
# Selevet: wake the timer thread only for a new earliest event (Donkey Kong Bananza)
#EDEN_TIMING_WAKE_ALL=1
# Orchid: Switch 2 graphics services run on their own host thread instead of emulated core 3
#EDEN_NX2_GSV_HOST_THREAD=0
# Orchid / Selevet: honour a swap interval above 1 only after N presents (Mario Kart World: 120)
#EDEN_NX2_SWAP_STABLE=0
# SmileyTatsu: Switch 2 pipelines are all built at boot and never evicted (less stutter in game)
# notsapinho: storage reads of Switch 2 games are not paced (faster loading, Pokopia boots ~13 s faster)

# --- Opt-in (off unless you set them) ---
# Selevet: CPU float math as in Accurate mode while CPU accuracy stays on Unsafe/Auto
#EDEN_CPU_ACCURATE_FLOAT=1
#EDEN_CPU_FUSED_FMA=1
#EDEN_CPU_GLOBAL_MONITOR=1
# Selevet: skip compute shaders by hash (each new compute shader is logged as "Nx2 first dispatch");
# put the last hashes before a "Device loss" here, comma separated, to work around a GPU hang
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_COMPUTE=

# --- On in Hortensia (Ocarina of Time only), as in Selevet's recommended file ---
# Lichii (zortos293), tuned by Selevet: Ocarina of Time fog/exposure/bloom reduction (the haze and
# glare are not fixed at the source yet). Delete these lines to see the game unmodified.
EDEN_NX2_OOT_VISUAL_WORKAROUND=1
EDEN_NX2_OOT_FOG_SCALE=0.35
EDEN_NX2_OOT_EXPOSURE_SCALE=0.75
EDEN_NX2_OOT_BLOOM_EXP_SCALE=1.2

# --- Opt-in, continued ---
# Lichii (zortos293) prototype: record render passes in parallel
#EDEN_NX2_PARALLEL_RECORD=1

# --- AMD (chuppatricky / Matt Artist), automatic ---
# Ocarina of Time shaders that crash or take minutes to build on AMD's Windows driver are built
# unoptimized on drivers older than 2.0.388. =1 does it on any AMD driver, =0 never.
#EDEN_NX2_AMD_SAFE_COMPILE=1
# Every graphics pipeline unoptimized on AMD's Windows driver (crash near the Deku Tree)
#EDEN_NX2_AMD_SAFE_COMPILE_GRAPHICS=1
